tabs.html:
VSOL V1600G0-B 4-Port GPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal for FTTH & FTTP Networks

The V1600G0-B 4-Port GPON OLT is a compact, high-speed optical line terminal designed for fiber-to-the-home (FTTH), fiber-to-the-premises (FTTP), and enterprise fiber networks. With 4 GPON ports, dual power modules (AC/DC), and high-speed uplink options, this OLT delivers reliable, scalable, and energy-efficient performance for ISPs, telecom providers, and enterprise fiber deployments.


Key Features 

  • 4 GPON Ports – Supports up to 512 ONUs with a 1:64 splitting ratio per port, ensuring high-density fiber connectivity.
  • High-Speed Uplinks – 2 x GE (RJ45) ports and 2 x 10GE (SFP+) ports for fast, stable data transmission.
  • Dual Power Modules (AC/DC) – Hot-swappable design for maximum uptime and redundancy, making it ideal for critical network environments.
  • Compact & Lightweight – 1U rack-mountable design, with a net weight of 2.95kg and a gross weight of 4.15kg, ensuring easy installation and space efficiency.
  • Low Power Consumption & Cost-Effective – Designed for energy-efficient operation, reducing operational costs while delivering superior network performance.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600G0-B
  • GPON Ports: 4 x GPON (PX20++)
  • Uplink Ports: 2 x GE (RJ45) + 2 x 10GE (SFP+)
  • Splitting Ratio: 1:64 per GPON port
  • Chassis: 1U, rack-mountable
  • Power Supply: Dual AC/DC (100-240V AC / -36V to -75V DC)
  • Net Weight: 2.95kg
  • Gross Weight: 4.15kg
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP Deployments – Provides high-speed fiber broadband to residential and business users.
  • Enterprise & Campus Networks – Supports high-bandwidth, low-latency applications for corporate and educational institutions.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – A cost-effective solution for expanding GPON services with scalable connectivity.
  • Smart City & IoT Solutions – Ensures seamless, high-speed connectivity for IoT devices, security surveillance, and automation systems.


Why Choose the V1600G0-B 4-Port GPON OLT?

  • Scalable & High-Performance – Supports 512 ONUs with high-speed uplinks for future network expansion.
  • Reliable Redundant Power Supply – Dual AC/DC hot-swappable power modules ensure continuous operation.
  • Optimized for High-Speed Networks – 10GE uplinks enable low-latency, high-speed data transfer.
  • Energy-Efficient & Space-Saving – 1U rack-mountable design with low power consumption.
